name: MS20XXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A Korg MS-20-style semi-modular mono synth, circuit-modelled from the MS-20 schematics: the KLM-307 OTA (MK2) and KORG35 (MK1) filter boards solved from their circuit equations, the capacitor-return highpass, Hz/V keyboard and CV sockets, the panel's voltage laws. Every jack of the MS-20 patch panel in its place, normalled like the hardware, patched by touch (tap a socket, tap the other end); an SQ-10-style 3 x 12 step sequencer on the panel; 62 factory patches with their cables. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. No Korg code; not made or endorsed by Korg.
